messages:
nina_sales: Quick sync - Helios Health procurement asked for a capability matrix that highlights deployment modes + a sample redacted inference log. Also asked for a POC quote for a 2-week Dedicated medium with 10k tokens/day. Sheet link: https://drive.redwood.com/helios/rfi_package.xlsx

leo_se: I'll handle the matrix and performance rows. Suggest we show RedPose-70B-quant for high-quality, and RedPose-13B-quant as cost/latency option.

maria_sec: I'll do the security questionnaire. Note: for medium Dedicated we need to call out burst capacity and expected p95 latency with 2x bursts. Also will include a sanitized log example and mention S3/syslog export options.

nina_sales: POC pricing ballpark? finance needs line items.

devops-bot: Reminder: Attachments due 2026-03-20 18:00 UTC.

leo_se: Ballpark: Dedicated m1-medium day rate = $1,600/day, support $1,500 flat, onboarding $3,000 one-time. Tokens 10k/day at $0.0007/token for trial. 14 days total estimate: compute $22,400, support $1,500, tokens $98, one-time $3,000 = $27,000 (rounded). I'll confirm with finance.

maria_sec: Sample redacted log pattern (put in drive /helios/logs_redacted.txt):
```
2026-03-19T09:31:02Z | req=req_zh12 | model=RedPose-13B-quant | profile=m1-medium | tokens_in=32 | tokens_out=120 | p50_ms=260 | p99_ms=480 | tenant=redacted | prompt_hash=sha256:bbb
```

nina_sales: Great. Please upload matrix + logs and tag #helios. Need final by EOD tomorrow.
